title: Form registry entry
description: One reviewed application form the PDF pipeline can fill (Mission v2 M4). Every entry is versioned and source-linked (BN-27 discipline), stays pilot-agnostic until the HACK-16 lock, and records the explicit per-form vault fill allowlist the boundary enforces.

kind.description: acroform = fill the interactive fields; flat = drawText coordinate fallback.

program.description: The benefits program this form serves — a committed placeholder until the pilot decision lands (HACK-16).

origin.description: generated_fixture = the committed synthetic sample; official_source = a real application form.

generator.description: For generated fixtures: the committed script that produced the PDF.

pdf_path.description: Repo-relative path of the template PDF this entry describes.

vault_field_allowlist.description: The ONLY vault fields a fill of this form may read, via readVaultFields (VAL-PDF-006): the pii fields it fills from plus any pii value its conditional fields' skip logic needs. Every id must be pii:true in the question spec.

name.description: The AcroForm field name exactly as discovered in the PDF.

label.description: Nearby label text as printed on the form (pdfjs extraction).

question.description: Plain-language question for the conversation flow — the reviewed LLM-assisted mapping of the field name + nearby label.

spec_question_id.description: Question-spec id this field pre-fills from, or null when the form collects something the spec does not ask (asked in the flow, stored as a form answer).

disposition.description: The field's reviewed disposition (full-form mapping, VAL-FIX-007): mapped = takes a person answer; every other value is the honest reason the pipeline leaves it blank, carried in disposition_reason.

disposition_reason.description: The honest per-field reason a non-mapped disposition leaves the field blank. Required whenever disposition is not "mapped".

export_value.description: A mapped checkbox's on-state export value as discovered in the template (the true side of its true/false semantics).

export_values.description: A mapped yes/no radio pair's discovered export values (the checked/unchecked sides).

display_format.description: Optional printed-date format for a mapped date question (e.g. "mm/dd/yyyy"): ISO yyyy-mm-dd answers render with the mm/dd/yyyy tokens replaced by the zero-padded date parts, in the format the form itself prints.

pii_likely.description: True when the field collects identity-like data: its value is sensitive-by-default and is omitted from client review/flow payloads.

answer_box.description: Flat-variant only: where the answer is drawn (page, baseline x/y) and the max width before shrinking.
